subject: Open asks & staggered closure plan for QBR runway
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Open asks & staggered closure plan for QBR runway

Team —

Thanks for the sync this morning. Per our conversation with Acme, there are a handful of open asks across product, infra and legal that we need to close ahead of next week’s QBR readout. I sketched a staggered closure plan and attached a lightweight runway table (QBR_runway_table_v2.xlsx). Please review and confirm owners / deadlines below.

Summary of open asks (owner -> ask -> suggested target):
- Product / Marissa: decide on model variant for feature flag experiment (owner: Marissa) -> target: 2027-06-11
- Infra / Vivek: finalize dedicated pool sizing + canary window (owner: Vivek) -> target: 2027-06-14
- Legal / Evelyn: final review of data retention clause with Acme (owner: Evelyn) -> target: 2027-06-12
- Platform / Karthik: add route-level fallback policy and throttling thresholds (owner: Karthik) -> target: 2027-06-15

Ask: can each owner reply with a one-line confirm + any blocker by end of day Friday? I’ve linked the tracker and included the initial runway matrix. Priya — bringing you in so Acme has visibility; feel free to flag any priority changes.

Attachments: QBR_runway_table_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Open asks & staggered closure plan for QBR runway

On Fri, Jun 4, 2027 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Thanks for the sync this morning. Per our conversation with Acme, there are a handful of open asks...

Confirming ownership and a small tweak to scope: for Product I want to split the model-variant decision into two pieces — 1) baseline variant for the demo (deadline 06/11) and 2) experiment rollout gating criteria (deadline 06/18). That keeps the demo on track while giving experimentation team extra runway. I updated the tracker (sheet: product-decisions).

Blockers: need final performance numbers from infra for the high-concurrency profile (Vivek, can you surface the 95th p99 numbers into the tracker?)

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Management | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Dan Li <dan.li@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Open asks & staggered closure plan for QBR runway

Thanks — I pulled the simulated p95/p99 numbers for the high-concurrency profile and uploaded a short note to the Drive link (see related link). Summary: with the dedicated pool we hit target latency at 85% of estimated traffic; for peak spikes we recommend the following canary plan and a temporary +15% buffer in pool sizing.

Proposed infra actions:
- Finalize dedicated pool sizing: allocate +15% buffer for first two weeks after rollout -> target 2027-06-14
- Canary window: staggered 20% -> 50% traffic over 48h with rollback hooks and preserved KV cache -> see attached canary_plan_v1.pdf -> target ready 2027-06-13

CC’ing Dan from Acme so they see the plan. If Legal needs any formal language for the rollback SLAs, I can work with Evelyn on that.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform | Redwood Inference

Attachment: canary_plan_v1.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Open asks & staggered closure plan for QBR runway

Got it — I’ll own the route-level fallback and throttling thresholds.
Target: 2027-06-15. No blockers from my side; I’ll update the tracker with thresholds and a short test plan by Monday.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@acme.com>, Dan Li <dan.li@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Open asks & staggered closure plan for QBR runway — decisions and next steps

Appreciate the quick responses — summarizing so we have a single source of truth before the QBR: 

Decisions (agreed):
- Product: demo baseline variant confirmed (Marissa) -> deadline 2027-06-11
- Product experiment gating criteria -> 2027-06-18
- Infra: dedicated pool +15% buffer; canary plan approved (Vivek) -> canary runbook ready 2027-06-13, pool finalized 2027-06-14
- Platform fallback/throttles (Karthik) -> 2027-06-15
- Legal data retention review (Evelyn) -> 2027-06-12

Action owners: please update the QBR_runway_table_v2.xlsx tracker with any final notes and mark the item status. I’ll collate a short one-page readout for the execs on Tuesday morning and include the canary plan appendix.

If anyone runs into a blocker, reply-all with the blocker tag so I can escalate. Thanks — and Priya / Dan, let us know if Acme needs us to accelerate any item.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
